name: Gideon C. Moody
role: Judge of Deadwood; senator-elect of the proposed state of Dakota
bio: Judge G. C. Moody of Deadwood was elected one of two senators in December 1885 by the legislature of the proposed state of southern Dakota meeting at Huron, which the Cow Boy called a farce. In January 1886 he was given the privilege of the floor of the U.S. Senate, recognition the paper doubted would go further.

moments.label: Elected senator by the Huron legislature
Admitted to the floor of the Senate

mentions: Chief Justice Edgerton sends his resignation to Washington and will enter the senatorial race against Judge Moody of Deadwood. To a man up a tree this looks as though Judge Edgerton had abandoned a very plump bird in the hahd for a very poor one in the bush. There is no state as yet…

…egislature of southern Dakota met at Huron on Monday. Govenor Mellette sent in his message Tuesday and Judges Moody and Edgerton were elected senators. We wonder if anything will finally come of what all in the north think is a gigantic farce.
